# Performance Trend

This folder captures the longitudinal progress and geographic disparities of clinical quality indicators across Danish healthcare regions. It currently highlights a specific divergence in the performance trajectory of Indikator 2, where the Capital Region demonstrates continued positive development while progress remains stagnant in Zealand and North Jutland. Because the available evidence is limited to a single claim, this area serves as a starting point for tracking broader systemic patterns in healthcare quality improvements over time.

## Pages

- [[performance-trend|Performance Trend]] — Tracks the longitudinal progress and regional disparities of clinical quality indicators, specifically highlighting stagnant development in Zealand and North Jutland compared to the Capital Region.
